name: draw-underline
title: Draw Underline
author: HoverUI (https://hoverui.com)
description: The rule draws from the edge the cursor actually crossed and retracts toward the edge it left, so the direction carries real information about your movement. It is described as the span it covers rather than as a scale with a flipped origin, so an interrupted sweep stays continuous and still retracts toward the edge you left by, from any point mid-draw. Render it AS your link with the `as` prop — focus does not travel down the tree, so a span wrapped in someone else's anchor would never see that link's focus and keyboard users would get nothing. Keyboard focus draws from the centre out, since there is no side to have come from. Under reduced motion the rule is committed fully drawn with no transition: direction is temporal and cannot survive the removal of motion, so what is kept is the rule itself. On touch and any device without hover it rests drawn, so the link still reads as a link. Note: the host is inline-block, so it will not wrap across lines mid-phrase.
